## What's Changed
* External solver refactoring by @jurajsic in https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/pull/432
* Fix soundness bugs in formula preprocessing (generate_identities, infer_alignment) and a crash on unasserted axiom variables by @vhavlena in https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/pull/535
* Fix capture and lookaround semantics in ECMA regex (#455, #456, #457, #472, #474, #476) by @Kumismar in https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/pull/533
* Fix whitespace class and dot semantics in ECMA regex (#453, #454) by @Kumismar in https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/pull/534
* Fix segfaults on empty (negated) character class (#458) by @Kumismar in https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/pull/532
* Reduce fresh variables and quantifiers in re.from_ecma2020 constraints (#495, #496, #506, #507) by @Kumismar in https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/pull/536
* Fix quantifier overflow and octal escape parsing in ECMA regex (#473, #477, #481) by @Kumismar in https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/pull/531
* Fix ECMAScript input reading and sanitization issues (#435, #475, #482) by @Kumismar in https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/pull/530
* Fix crashes and memory-safety bugs (#466, #467, #486, #490, #519) by @vhavlena in https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/pull/547


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/VeriFIT/z3-noodler/compare/v1.7.2...v1.8.0
